Dumb Biryani

A show with a mind of its own.

Made withRevolio Originals
Our partOriginal concept · Visual identity · Production · Experiential launch

Here’s the idea.

Arhaan Khan, Dev Raiyani, and Arush Verma turn the podcast format into an internet-first reality show.

We built Dumb Biryani end to end, giving it an intentionally lo-fi, anti-art visual language and a format that leaves space for the unexpected. Guests range from Neeraj Goyat to Bollywood paparazzi and the Fabulous Wives.

The launch took the show beyond the screen and into Mumbai, with a themed food truck and flyers. It is a Revolio original: a world we built, rather than a brief we were handed.

An original format needs a personality that holds together on screen, in the feed, and out in the world.
